violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. - OBSERVED: a food employee failed to change gloves and wash hands after handling raw hamburger and before cooking food at cook line.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS educated the food employee and prompted the food employee to wash hand properly.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the @LOCATION@ being used @OBSERVATION@. - OBSERVED: bar hand sink was used as a dump sink.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS educated CFMs. Bar hand sink will be used as hand sink only.

violations.title: Cooling from Ambient to 41F, No More than 4 Hours
violations.observation: The following food item prepared from ambient air temperature ingredients is not being adequately cooled to 41F or less within 4 hours: - OBSERVED: cut fruits (honeydew and cantaloupe) (43-45f) were stored in continental 3-door upright cooler for 4.5 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be cooled within 4 hours to 41F or less if prepared from ingredients at ambient air temperature (i.e. reconstituted foods and canned tuna). - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM discarded the cut fruits.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Cooling, Heating, Holding Equipment Sufficient
violations.observation: OBSERVED: six refrigerators are not working properly.
violations.corrective_action: - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: (1) time as a public health control procedure will be applied for the time/temperature control for safety (tcs) food by the end of today; (2) a work order has been placed.

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: OBSERVED: a bar tender working in the food service area without proper hair restraints.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS prompted the bar tender to put on hair restraints.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: - OBSERVED: in-use utensils in dipper wells with the water turned off.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS educated the CFMs and food employees. Water turned on.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: - OBSERVED: ambient temperature of 4-drawer prep cooler (salad) was 49f, 4-drawer prep cooler (grill) was 75f, 4-drawer prep cooler (saute) was 71f, 2-drawer prep was 50f, continental 1-door upright cooler was 44f, and continental 3-door upright cooler was 43f.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: please obtain urgent service for the units within 3 calendar days.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink at @LOCATION@ is equipped with separate cold and hot water faucets rather than a mixing valve or combination faucet. OBSERVED HOT WATER TEMPERATURE OF HAND SINK IN WARE WASHING AREA AT 91F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PLEASE OBTAIN URGENT SERVICE FOR THE HAND SINK.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: BAR DISHWASHER (RIGHT UNIT) IS NOT SANITIZING. OBSERVED A SANITIZING RINSE CONCENTRATION OF LESS THAN 50PPM CHLORINE SOLUTION.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. PLEASE USE OTHER DISHWASHERS TO SANITIZE ALL FOOD CONTACT SURFACES.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: ROASTED GARLIC (76F) IN OIL WAS STORED BY THE GRILL FOR ABOUT 1 HOUR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO DISCARD THE FOOD IN NOT MORE THAN 3 HOURS. MANAGER HAS REQUESTED THE USED OF THPC MOVING FORWARD.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: PICKLED ONION (46F) WAS STORED AT EXPO FOR 1 HOUR AND 45 MINUTES. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO DISCARD THE FOOD IN NO MORE THAN 2 HOURS. MANAGER HAS REQUESTED THE USE OF TPHC MOVING FORWARD.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth.
